items.title: Rokkatei reports unauthorized client credit card use | NHK WORLD-JAPAN News
items.why: Card-on-file misuse at a merchant is a fraud-risk signal worth weighing when vetting merchant and retail partners.
items.summary_ai: Japanese firm Rokkatei has disclosed unauthorized use of client credit cards.
items.take: Card-on-file misuse at a merchant is a fraud-risk signal worth weighing when vetting merchant and retail partners.
